plan_version: journal — BrainLat + ds004504, analysis plan of 2026-11-19
working_title: What Does Resting-State EEG Add to Demographics in Alzheimer's Disease? Incremental Value, Confounding, and Transportability Across Two Cohorts
brainlat_channel_mapping: nearest BioSemi electrode to each 10-20 position (angle on the unit sphere, one-to-one assignment by linear_sum_assignment)

greek_band_harmonization.reason: BrainLat was distributed band-passed with a Butterworth 0.5-40 Hz filter, order 8, zero phase (Prado et al., 2023); the ds004504 derivatives with 0.5-45 Hz (README)

preprocessing.normalization: RMS per subject (does not change the features)
preprocessing.sampling_rate: native (512 Hz in BrainLat; 500 Hz in ds004504)
preprocessing.epoch_rejection: none, as in the conference paper (only epochs with NaN/inf features are dropped)

XGBoost.scale_pos_weight: n_HC/n_AD in the training epochs of each fold

validation.scheme: leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) within each cohort; training at the epoch level; subject P(AD) = mean over epochs
validation.bootstrap: subjects resampled with replacement, stratified by class

rq1.score: logit of the out-of-fold P(AD), standardised within the cohort (OR per 1 SD)
rq1.test: statistic: likelihood-ratio (1 df) of the logistic model demographics + score; p-value by parametric bootstrap of the whole LOSO under H0, because the naive test with cross-validated scores can be liberal (Hofling & Tibshirani, 2008; Shang et al., 2025); OR CI by profile likelihood (descriptive)

null_bootstrap.scheme: y* ~ Bernoulli(P(AD | covariates)) from the null model; LOSO re-run with y*; sequential stopping of Besag & Clifford (1991)

rq1.independent: valid check without resampling: score of the model trained on the OTHER cohort, beyond demographics (Dinga et al., 2020: the parametric test is valid on independent data)
rq1.firth_rule: Firth if the MLE does not converge or any standardised |beta| exceeds 10
rq1.delta_auc: leave-one-out balanced logistic regression (demographics vs demographics + EEG score); descriptive, not tested
rq1.e_value: VanderWeele & Ding (2017); RR approx. sqrt(OR) because the outcome is common
rq1.e_value_reference: in BrainLat, OR of the EEG score adjusted for age + sex vs + education (how much education matters)
rq1.brainlat_site_check: age + sex + education + site; check, outside the reading rule
rq1.pooled: AD ~ cohort + covariates with cohort-specific effects (BrainLat: age, sex, education; Greek: age, sex) + common z_EEG; heterogeneity: + cohort x z_EEG (LR, 1 df)

brainlat_matching.algorithm: optimal (linear_sum_assignment), without replacement, ties broken by age

rq2.aauc: check: covariate-adjusted AUC (Janes & Pepe, 2009), with the score standardised by the linear regression in the controls (BrainLat: age, sex, education; Greek: age, sex)
rq2.score: out-of-fold P(AD) of the RF, without retraining

rq3.primary: BrainLat -> Greek: RF trained on all of BrainLat, frozen and applied once
rq3.recalibration: none; subject-level AUC is the primary metric
rq3.calibration: descriptive: slope, intercept with slope fixed at 1 (calibration-in-the-large; Van Calster et al., 2016) and Brier score
rq3.per_cohort_standardization: secondary: each feature standardised (mean and SD of all epochs) within its own cohort, without labels, before training and applying; outside the reading rule

exploratory.brainlat: MoCA in AD (parallel to the MMSE); partial Spearman rho adjusted for age and education
exploratory.brainlat_secondary: IFS in AD (continuity with the conference paper); same adjustment
exploratory.greek: MMSE in AD; partial Spearman rho adjusted for age

per_feature_descriptive: each feature (subject mean, standardised) beyond the cohort covariates; OR per 1 SD, profile CI, Benjamini-Hochberg q within cohort; outside the reading rule

reading_rules.RQ1a: adds if the (two-sided) null-bootstrap p is below 0.05
reading_rules.RQ1b: adds if the one-sided (OR > 1) null-bootstrap p is below 0.05
reading_rules.RQ1c: consistent if the cohort x EEG interaction has p >= 0.05 and the ORs point the same way
reading_rules.RQ2: survives if the 95% CI of the confounding-free AUC (or concordance) lies above 0.5
reading_rules.RQ3: transports if the 95% CI of the AUC in the other cohort lies above 0.5

provenance.note: One-to-one translation of keys, feature names and descriptions (Razao_* -> Ratio_*). All numerical settings, seeds, models and reading rules are unchanged.
